surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 36 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Mutaffifin (Defrauding) is the 83th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 36 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌ لِلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ويل للمطففين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe to those who give less [than due]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe to those who give short measure

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: الَّذِينَ إِذَا اكْتَالُوا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الذين اذا اكتالوا على الناس يستوفون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who demand of other people full measure for themselves

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but give less than they should when it is they who weigh or measure for others

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do these people not realize that they will be raised up

ayahs.translation_saheeh: For a tremendous Day
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on a mighty Day

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a Day when everyone will stand before the Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كلا ان كتاب الفجار لفي سجين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No indeed! The list of the wicked is in Sijjin––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And what can make you know what is sijjeen
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: what will explain to you what Sijjin is?––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a clearly numbered list

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Woe on that day to the deniers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who deny the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: those who deny the Day of Judgement

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما يكذب به الا كل معتد اثيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Only the evil aggressor denies it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذا تتلى عليه اياتنا قال اساطير الاولين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when Our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘Ancient fables!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كلا ۖ بل ۜ ران على قلوبهم ما كانوا يكسبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No indeed! Their hearts are encrusted with what they have done

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَلَّا إِنَّهُمْ عَنْ رَبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَمَحْجُوبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كلا انهم عن ربهم يومئذ لمحجوبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened offfrom their Lord

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they will burn in Hell

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ثم يقال هذا الذي كنتم به تكذبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and they will be told, ‘This is what you called a lie.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كلا ان كتاب الابرار لفي عليين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No indeed! The list of the truly good is in 'Illiyyin––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: what will explain to you what 'Illiyyin is?––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a clearly written list

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: witnessed by those brought near

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The truly good will live in bliss

ayahs.translation_saheeh: On adorned couches, observing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: seated on couches, gazing around

ayahs.translation_saheeh: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: You will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will be served a sealed nectar

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكࣱۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ختامه مسك ۚ وفي ذلك فليتنافس المتنافسون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: its seal [perfumed with] a fragrant herb––let those who strive, strive for this––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And its mixture is of Tasneem
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: mixed with the water of Tasnim

ayahs.translation_saheeh: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a spring from which those brought near will drink

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا كَانُوا مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان الذين اجرموا كانوا من الذين امنوا يضحكون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The wicked used to laugh at the believers––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they would wink at one another when the believers passed by them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِذَا انْقَلَبُوا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمُ انْقَلَبُوا فَكِهِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذا انقلبوا الى اهلهم انقلبوا فكهين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: joke about them when they got back to their own people

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوا إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ لَضَالُّونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذا راوهم قالوا ان هؤلاء لضالون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and say, when they saw them, ‘These people are misguided,’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But they had not been sent as guardians over them
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: though they were not sent to be their keepers

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَالْيَوْمَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاليوم الذين امنوا من الكفار يضحكون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so today the believers are laughing at the disbelievers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: On adorned couches, observing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: as they sit on couches, gazing around

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ الْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هل ثوب الكفار ما كانوا يفعلون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Have the disbelievers [not] been repaid for their deeds
